panels.title: Domain identity and desired/active operational state
panels.description: Authoritative PostgreSQL state: lifecycle, revisions, DNS verification/drift, proxy placement and cells, cache, TLS, security, WAF, and pool profiles.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM grafana_domain_operational_metadata WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw}
SELECT 100 * countIf(status >= 500) / nullIf(count(),0) AS percent FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT if(count() = 0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)), countIf(origin_error != '')) AS failures FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT if(count() = 0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)), countIf(tls_error != '')) AS failures FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

SELECT if(count() = 0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)), countIf(rcode IN ('SERVFAIL','REFUSED') OR outcome NOT IN ('answered','noerror'))) AS failures FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

defaults.noValue: No DNS traffic in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt64)), countIf(security_action = 'block' OR waf_action = 'block')) AS blocks FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Eligible HIT / (HIT + MISS + EXPIRED + STALE). BYPASS is deliberately excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * countIf(cache_status = 'HIT') / nullIf(countIf(cache_status IN ('HIT','MISS','EXPIRED','STALE')),0) AS hit_percent FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Busiest edge share
panels.description: The busiest edge's share of domain traffic. High values can indicate placement or routing imbalance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * max(requests) / nullIf(sum(requests),0) AS busiest_edge_percent FROM (SELECT edge_id,count() AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY edge_id)

panels.title: Raw retention completeness
panels.description: Raw detail and exact percentiles retain seven days. RED means the selected range begins before available raw data; use volume aggregates for long-range totals.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 1, 0) AS complete FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} LIMIT 1

panels.title: HTTP request rate
panels.description: Raw for ≤7 days, hourly for >7–400 days, daily beyond 400 days. Each branch is disabled outside its valid retention range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time,sum(requests) AS requests FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time,count() AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) <= 604800 AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY time UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_hourly WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) > 604800 AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) <= 34560000 AND $__timeFilter(interval_start) GROUP BY time UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_daily WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) > 34560000 AND $__timeFilter(interval_start) GROUP BY time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT sum(requests) AS requests,sum(bytes_in) AS bytes_in,sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out FROM (SELECT count() AS requests,sum(bytes_in) AS bytes_in,sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) <= 604800 AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) UNION ALL SELECT sum(requests),sum(bytes_in),sum(bytes_out) FROM cdnf.edge_hourly WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) > 604800 AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) <= 34560000 AND $__timeFilter(interval_start) UNION ALL SELECT sum(requests),sum(bytes_in),sum(bytes_out) FROM cdnf.edge_daily WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND dateDiff('second',$__fromTime,$__toTime) > 34560000 AND $__timeFilter(interval_start))

SELECT concat(toString(intDiv(status,100)),'xx') AS class,status,count() AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY class,status ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT cache_status,count() AS requests,round(100 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (),2) AS percent FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY cache_status ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 32

panels.title: Origin and TLS diagnosis (raw seven-day detail)
Origin latency: average and exact p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Exact quantiles are computed from raw origin_latency_ms samples. Long ranges can be partial because raw retention is seven days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time,avg(origin_latency_ms) AS average,quantileExact(0.50)(origin_latency_ms) AS p50,quantileExact(0.95)(origin_latency_ms) AS p95,quantileExact(0.99)(origin_latency_ms) AS p99 FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND origin_latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Origin errors, primary/backup role, and transitions

targets.rawSql: SELECT origin_role,origin_transition,origin_error,count() AS events,max(occurred_at) AS latest FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (origin_error != '' OR origin_transition != 'none' OR origin_role = 'backup') GROUP BY origin_role,origin_transition,origin_error ORDER BY latest DESC,events DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No origin errors or transitions in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT tls_error,count() AS events,max(occurred_at) AS latest FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND tls_error != '' GROUP BY tls_error ORDER BY latest DESC,events DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No TLS failures in selected range

panels.title: Security, WAF, and compression (raw seven-day detail)

targets.rawSql: SELECT security_action,security_reason,count() AS events,max(occurred_at) AS latest FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY security_action,security_reason ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: WAF action, rule, score, body limit, exclusions

targets.rawSql: SELECT waf_profile,waf_action,waf_rule_id,waf_score,waf_body_limit,waf_exclusion_id,count() AS events,max(occurred_at) AS latest FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND waf_action != 'off' GROUP BY waf_profile,waf_action,waf_rule_id,waf_score,waf_body_limit,waf_exclusion_id ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No WAF events in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT waf_profile,waf_action,round(avg(waf_processing_us),1) AS average_us,quantileExact(0.95)(waf_processing_us) AS p95_us,quantileExact(0.99)(waf_processing_us) AS p99_us,count() AS events FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND waf_action != 'off' GROUP BY waf_profile,waf_action ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 32

defaults.noValue: No WAF events in selected range

panels.title: Compression encoding, profile, fallback, and ratio

targets.rawSql: SELECT compression_encoding,compression_profile,compression_fallback,round(avg(compression_ratio),2) AS average_ratio,quantileExact(0.95)(compression_ratio) AS p95_ratio,count() AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY compression_encoding,compression_profile,compression_fallback ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: HTTP request dimensions and bounded paths
Requests by hostname, method, and event type

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname,method,event_type,count() AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY hostname,method,event_type ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT edge_id,count() AS requests,sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out,round(100 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (),2) AS percent FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY edge_id ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT country,continent,count() AS requests,sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY country,continent ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Top paths (query strings removed at ingestion; bounded to 100)
panels.description: Paths are sanitized and capped at 2,048 bytes by Vector. This panel never reads query strings or client identifiers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT path,count() AS requests,countIf(status >= 500) AS five_xx,sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY path ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time,count() AS queries FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

defaults.noValue: No DNS traffic in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT rcode,qtype,outcome,count() AS queries FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY rcode,qtype,outcome ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No DNS traffic in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT dns_cluster,country,continent,count() AS queries FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY dns_cluster,country,continent ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 200

defaults.noValue: No DNS traffic in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT qname,qtype,rcode,count() AS queries FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY qname,qtype,rcode ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 100

defaults.noValue: No DNS traffic in selected range

panels.title: Recent aggregate errors for incident response
Recent HTTP error aggregates
panels.description: Grouped sanitized fields only. No client IPs, headers, cookies, authorization data, queries, or bodies.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(occurred_at) AS interval,hostname,status,origin_error,tls_error,security_action,security_reason,waf_action,waf_rule_id,count() AS events FROM cdnf.edge_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (status >= 500 OR origin_error != '' OR tls_error != '' OR security_action = 'block' OR waf_action = 'block') GROUP BY interval,hostname,status,origin_error,tls_error,security_action,security_reason,waf_action,waf_rule_id ORDER BY interval DESC,events DESC LIMIT 200

defaults.noValue: No aggregate errors in selected range

panels.title: Recent DNS failure aggregates
panels.description: Grouped qname/rcode/outcome only; raw client identifiers are never selected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(occurred_at) AS interval,qname,qtype,rcode,outcome,dns_cluster,count() AS events FROM cdnf.dns_events WHERE domain_id = ${domain_id:raw} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (rcode IN ('SERVFAIL','REFUSED') OR outcome NOT IN ('answered','noerror')) GROUP BY interval,qname,qtype,rcode,outcome,dns_cluster ORDER BY interval DESC,events DESC LIMIT 200

defaults.noValue: No DNS failures in selected range

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, display_name || ' (' || name || ')' AS __text FROM domains WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(display_name), id LIMIT 10000
list.label: Domain
list.name: domain_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, display_name || ' (' || name || ')' AS __text FROM domains WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(display_name), id LIMIT 10000
